TARGET=1332195000
while true; do
  D_SIZE=$(ssh westb-48145 "stat -c%s /root/entrainment_gated_ft/models/340M-20B-DeltaNet-hybrid-3-1/model.safetensors 2>/dev/null || echo 0")
  H_SIZE=$(ssh westb-48145 "stat -c%s /root/entrainment_gated_ft/models/340M-20B-HGRN-hybrid-3-1/model.safetensors 2>/dev/null || echo 0")
  D_PCT=$((D_SIZE * 100 / TARGET))
  H_PCT=$((H_SIZE * 100 / TARGET))
  
  if [ "$D_SIZE" -ge "$TARGET" ] && [ "$H_SIZE" -ge "$TARGET" ]; then
    echo "BOTH_DONE DeltaNet=${D_SIZE} HGRN=${H_SIZE}"
    break
  elif [ "$D_SIZE" -ge "$TARGET" ]; then
    echo "DeltaNet_DONE HGRN=${H_PCT}% (${H_SIZE}/${TARGET})"
  elif [ "$H_SIZE" -ge "$TARGET" ]; then
    echo "HGRN_DONE DeltaNet=${D_PCT}% (${D_SIZE}/${TARGET})"
  fi
  
  # Also check if wget processes died
  D_ALIVE=$(ssh westb-48145 "ps -p 872517 -o pid= 2>/dev/null" || true)
  H_ALIVE=$(ssh westb-48145 "ps -p 872660 -o pid= 2>/dev/null" || true)
  
  if [ -z "$D_ALIVE" ] && [ "$D_SIZE" -lt "$TARGET" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: DeltaNet wget died at ${D_PCT}% (${D_SIZE} bytes)"
    break
  fi
  if [ -z "$H_ALIVE" ] && [ "$H_SIZE" -lt "$TARGET" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: HGRN wget died at ${H_PCT}% (${H_SIZE} bytes)"
    break
  fi
  
  sleep 60
done
